written: 2026-11-23, before any round-5 exercise was written
theory: The engine's leftover failures are not compositions of its operators (opening every gate, a third search step and the best reordering add 1-3% reach, SeedLM-37~39): they need knowledge the library lacks. Round 3's operators, written for 489 real failures with shared needs, raised the locked test 57 -> 68; round 4's, written for the 114 idiosyncratic real failures left, were never used on the development fifth. The pilot asks whether knowledge can be injected blind: operators written for failures on exercises a teacher invents, measured on real tasks no teacher of this round has seen
stage_1: one teacher (Opus 5.5) invents 300 practice exercises with a reference solution and three asserts each (docs/round5_task_guide.md, scripts/round5_task_check.py); exercises too close to an evaluation task or to a training-side real task (six-word run or content Jaccard >= 0.6, scripts/seedlm3_decontaminate.py's rules) are dropped
stage_2: the shipped engine on the kept exercises; those it fails by their asserts form the bank, those it solves the regression set
stage_3: one operator teacher writes a pack for the bank with the round-4 rules (docs/round4_teacher_guide.md, adapted), seeing only the invented exercises
primary_measure: the extra pool's training part (434 real tasks with reference solutions, which no round-5 teacher sees): tasks newly solved under the strict judge (asserts, then no conflict with the reference on the probes) by the shipped engine plus the pack, minus tasks it breaks. Supported if at least 5; not supported if at most 1; inconclusive otherwise
secondary_measures: the same count under the lenient judge
the pack's own bank: failures fixed (reported, not evidence)
only if supported: the development fifth once, both judges, the main system with the pack against 69 and 58
not_tuned_on: the 434 training-side real tasks (measured once, after the pack is frozen)

outcome.primary: 434 training-side real tasks with the shipped engine plus r5_pilot (1,057 operators): no first program changed; newly solved minus broken, strict, 0: not supported (reports/seedlm/round5_pilot_transfer.json). The development fifth was not measured, as registered
secondary: the pack's own bank: 209 of 268 invented exercises newly solved, none of the 19 solved ones broken (the teacher's report, reports/seedlm/round5_pilot_teacher_report.json)
diagnosis on the 434 (exploration): a pack gate opens on 60 descriptions, and on none of them does a pack operator take part in any of the 40 programs that reproduce the example
outcome.reading: Knowledge written for exercises a teacher invents does not reach real tasks: the gates sometimes open, but the operators compute something other than what the real tasks ask. The exercise teacher, told not to reproduce benchmark tasks, also left out every classic topic it recognised from MBPP or HumanEval (Roman numerals, coin change, run-length encoding, palindromes ...), which removed exactly the overlap with real tasks; a second pilot would have to separate a classic concept, which is general knowledge, from a benchmark's wording
